presentationChangeReason: Four static PCF samples were incorrectly combined as if there were two. Both maps now use their own averages. Offset taps also use their local receiver-plane depth; normalization alone exposed self-shadow stripes in the wet road highlight. These corrections intentionally change shadow pixels; equality with the old incorrect weights is not claimed. Original equality/frame gates are still recorded and not waived.
provenance: Baseline source and dist were built together before edits; compiled baseline stayed unchanged through all 36 cases and wet captures and is archived under the before report. Changed renderer passed full checks and was rebuilt before after capture. Measured harness fingerprints are identical. Reuses the complete radiance-projection-after baseline and its exact frozen runner/harness. Four static PCF samples and two dynamic samples are normalized separately before the existing map combination; shared counts drive the shader loops and inactive dynamic-map visibility. A receiver-plane gradient from geometric position derivatives corrects comparison depth for each offset PCF tap, with a finite neutral fallback for singular light projections. Derivatives are computed before bounds returns. Sample offsets, existing normal/constant/caster biases, comparison samplers, depth maps, all render features and physics are retained. The earlier CPU fallback-key lifecycle repair also separates the source snapshots, but is inactive in the built-in live route measured here. Intentional shadow pixel changes are recorded, and no pixel-equality or performance claim overrides the observed failed gates.
interpretation: Actual native three-way reports with identical scene inputs and physical hashes. Engine effects/shading differ from peers; no equal-quality competitive claim. Every Engine PNG channel uses only the observed before repeat range, without a tolerance; every wet RGBA8 and finite HDR reflection channel is compared exactly. Failed gates remain failed. CPU/GPU p95 from sequential local runs can vary with clock/load; exclusive GPU use was not established. Headless RAF is not display FPS.
